protocol.action_trace_scope: Actual AP/band/MCS end-of-slot state sampled every100ms plus planning-decision records; not a complete physical event log.
protocol.activation: Offline research only. No physical car or network commands; no production, SOTA, novelty or universal claim. Application RadioMap default remains unchanged.
protocol.checkpoint_rule: Smallest validation weighted mean-field RMSE +0.5 AP-choice regret; identical all families. No family/lambda selection.
protocol.collection_limits: Training uses a fixed numerical behavior policy; observation shift under learned policies remains possible. Training is balanced across handover costs. The six validation sites use four fast and two slow collections under the index rule, so validation is not fully balanced.
protocol.conditions: Even evaluation site main, odd site existing hidden drift; same public CAD and planned routes, not physical warehouse transfer.
protocol.controller: Fixed for every arm before new data: canonical reactive_rescue with OutageBudgetGate at 0.03 s; OutageUtility with a 30 s horizon at 4 s. No persistent stays, new uncertainty veto, or controller search. Existing admission uses a heuristic outage-cost surrogate, not a safety guarantee.
protocol.development_gate: At each cost, seed-averaged command miss rate of semantic_jepa must be strictly below RadioMap and supervised, and no greater than context_jepa and semantic_aux. All four reference engineering margins must pass, with no runtime/source/accounting failure. This is a descriptive veto, not significance. Open confirmation only for costs passing this rule; no refitting or threshold selection after development.
protocol.diagnostics: Report per-band online and EMA target rank/std, fixed-geometry RF sensitivity, forecast RMSE/route-delta/AP-regret, training and inference compute, and every negative/null result. Direct horizon anchoring removes recursive residual summation in this model; finite trials do not bound indefinite closed-loop loss.
protocol.endpoint_sensitivity: Preserve packet generation and queue semantics: no artificial flush. Candidate unresolved commands count as misses and reference unresolved commands as successes for conservative comparisons. The audit-only kernel exports exact per-robot counts, pending ages and cumulative counters.
protocol.engineering: Against each of the four primary references: candidate mean worst-decile loss with pending commands counted as misses <= reference observed +1/(20*T); global maximum observed silence <= reference +0.05 s; original-demand video fraction >= reference -0.01; bulk delivery >=0.99 reference. Also report zero-margin results. These empirical margins are not production qualification.
protocol.families_comparison: Three independently fitted single members per new family are evaluated separately. Strong learned-prior rolling RadioMap is the primary numerical reference. Frozen original fleet hybrid JEPA uses its original API/map prior and three-member ensemble as a secondary practical comparator. Primary means average paired training members within each whole site. Neither members, robots nor packets are additional independent sites.
protocol.latency: Before development, measure full predictor calls on the calibration site in three repetitions of 24 sequential decisions. For each cold/warm/refit regime all 12 new fits share max(0.01,ceil(2*max_arm_p95*100)/100). Optimized RadioMap and the frozen original fleet ensemble receive their own measured profile. Every arm pays the same 0.5 s FIFO delay. Startup/checkpoint loading is measured separately outside the request loop. Any actual call cost exceeding its sealed compute charge vetoes the claim; never retime after outcomes.
protocol.primary: At each development-passing cost compare semantic_jepa with RadioMap, supervised, context_jepa and semantic_aux. Average three paired training seeds within site; use 20,000 fixed-seed whole-site bootstrap draws. Require upper quantile 1-0.05/8 below zero for observed and conservative endpoint outcomes. Keep the full eight-comparison multiplicity budget if only one cost is tested. Claim benefit at a cost only if all four comparisons and engineering/integrity gates pass. A both-cost claim requires both costs.
protocol.replays: On the first confirmation site replay RadioMap, supervised seed0 and semantic_jepa seed0 at each tested cost. Require exact results, forecast hashes, delivered telemetry and decision/action traces.
protocol.runtime_observations: Actual completed/delivered scans from existing delivered-telemetry kernel, shared conditional sixty-second cadence-five warm start. Public localization/routes out-of-band.
protocol.study: Decision-aligned privileged semantic JEPA with delivered warehouse observations
protocol.training_collection_handover_rule: 0.03 s when floor(site_index/4) is even, otherwise 4 s; numerical collection policy fixed and identical for every learned family.
protocol.training_collection_profile_scope: Declared data-collection queue assumption, not measured runtime or hardware qualification. Actual evaluation profiles are separately calibrated and sealed before development.
protocol.training_observations: All families share actual numerical-policy native collection with scan completion, Nakagami fading/blockage, outages, successful-control report delivery and FIFO completion. The sixty-second cadence-five survey is a common conditional warm start. Collect for query duration +30 seconds so future context targets come from delivered observations too; truth remains a separate simulator label.
protocol.training_privilege: All families receive the same simulator future mean-field SNR labels in their common supervised loss. The semantic teacher uses only these labels and the public map anchor: (truth - map_mean)/10 and (truth - 5 dB)/10. The second coordinate is a fixed absolute SNR margin, not relative AP gain or calibrated PHY risk. This is privileged supervised semantic JEPA, not label-free learning. No extra actual future positions enter the semantic teacher.
